name: Daniel Sarcos
scope: Dedicated Sarcos audit with the real shared engine and an independently opened native preview tab. Only this report and tests/character-audits/sarcos.test.ts were written in the repository. No runtime edits, new server, commits or child agents.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: Daniel Sarcos, Venezuelan television presenter associated in the preserved dossier with Súper sábado sensacional and televised contests. No new biographical research was performed.
identityAndPortrayal.referenceViewed: The preserved portrait shows slicked-back short dark hair with gray sides, a broad smile, clean-shaven face, dark suit, white shirt and dark tie. The inspected atlas preserves those traits and adds the established microphone.
identityAndPortrayal.fictionalAdaptation: The bouncing gift, Premio sensacional and three show/prize combo names fit the established host theme; combat is fictional.
identityAndPortrayal.audio: Source inspection confirms generic actor effort/pain clips and a synthesized jackpot cue, with no real-person dialogue. Audio playback was not listened to.

movementAndStance.movement: Starting x540 on the Poliedro floor, right for24 steps reaches x644.0717109708025 and facing+1. Then left for24 steps reaches x548.72800663896 and facing-1. Both player sides reproduce the same results.
movementAndStance.jump: After releasing movement for10 steps, jump reaches y454.6 after10 steps. A second jump is accepted, a third rejected, and100 further steps return to floor y554, grounded=true, jumps=0.
movementAndStance.ordinaryAttacks: At gap80, light connects once on active tick6 for7.3542 damage; heavy connects once on active tick11 for13.6578 damage against Javier. Both produce outward knockback and obey front guard, preserving HP100. All checks pass on both sides.
movementAndStance.visual: All eight actual production drawSprite poses were inspected in both facings: welcome0, guard1, walk2/3, tucked jump4, pointing light/special5, kick6 and recoil7. Heads, hands, feet and microphone remain coherent; no borrowed shoe fragment or incorrect facing was observed.

special.name: Premio sensacional
special.startingState: After the complete510-tick intro: side0 Sarcos x180 facing right, Javier x460; mirrored side1 Sarcos x900 facing left, Javier x620; both grounded y554 and energy100. Increment special once. Front guard holds block; rear guard holds block plus right for side0 target / left for side1 target.
special.contact: One prize emits at relative tick18, observed vx±6, vy-5.65, damage16.32 and bounces2. Idle/front contact at relative tick49; moving rear guard contact at66. Idle/rear lose16.8096 HP (16×1.02×1.03) and record one hit. Front guard preserves HP100 and records a block. Removal and follow-up waits confirm no duplicate hit.
special.twoBounces: With gap830 and an idle target beyond blast range: first bounce at relative tick58 / age41, y533, vy-6.2625, one remaining; second at tick93 / age76, y533, vy-4.490625, zero remaining. Side0 bounce x474/684; side1 x606/396. Third floor contact at relative tick118 / age101 removes the prize and emits exactly one explosion at x834 or mirrored x246, y534.484375. No target damage occurs.
special.terminalBlastGuards: At relative tick118, idle/front guard use gap720; rear guard uses gap550 to allow for its blocking walk during the arc. Both sides produce one terminal blast. Idle/rear lose16.8096 HP and record one hit; front preserves HP100 with a block. Ten further calls cause no duplicate damage.
special.energyGate: Energy24 rejects special on both sides; energy100 spends25 at activation before passive regeneration and hit rewards.
special.rangeInterpretation: The physical arc and85-pixel terminal blast can reach beyond nominal570 metadata range. Direct contact consumes the gift early, so a target in its path need not see both bounces. These are current expected mechanics, not demonstrated defects.

attacksAndCombos.baseCombo: Calienta el show (light→heavy) connects both strikes with chase inputs after knockback on both sides; Javier HP75.898 at elapsed simulation tick66; heavy bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.advancedCombo: Doble sorpresa (light→light→heavy) connects all three with chase inputs on both sides; Javier HP64.4238 at elapsed tick111; heavy bonus7. At zero wins the same chain retains Calienta el show and bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.recognition: Separate gap140 whiff-chain checks verify input-history names and bonuses. Fully connected sequences independently verify all strikes can land.
attacksAndCombos.definitive: Premio mayor requires three wins and75 energy. At gap200 and active tick9 it hits once on both sides for41.7768 damage, leaving Javier HP58.2232: (28×1.02+12)×1.03. Zero/two wins, or three wins with74 energy, reject it. It uses the shared close-range super.

cpuFight.method: Complete intro, wait180 calls for CPU offense, then chase and issue real light/heavy/special/super, guard and jump inputs. Compare the entire final MatchState across two independent runs.
cpuFight.limitation: This deterministic exercised fight is not a balance benchmark. Dedicated attacks and combo checks cover light hits separately.

introAndSelection.name: Bienvenida con los brazos abiertos
introAndSelection.method: preview_status, then new tab with reuseExistingTab:false. Imported actual loadSprite, drawSprite, drawPresentation and drawIntroCinematic into ephemeral page canvases. Every preview operation explicitly targeted the own tab.
introAndSelection.presentationSamples: Intro/selection sampled at progress0/.3/.65/1 in both facings: free palm opens while painted microphone stays in hand; return to frame1 guard. Progress remains1 at5600ms.
introAndSelection.cinematicSamples: Actual cinematic P1 Sarcos at ticks80/168 and P2 Sarcos at260/348 show welcome/completed guard. Faces and palms fit the cinematic panels and face the rival.
introAndSelection.oneShot: Selection and entrance progress clamp at2800ms. Gameplay movement and special inputs remain inactive through the shared510-tick intro; playing starts at510 with rival-facing orientation.
introAndSelection.transientFailure: Initial body-replacement canvas disappeared before screenshot; the app lobby was captured instead during active development hot reloads. A fixed overlay then successfully produced the saved production-renderer captures. No alternate browser or new server was used.
introAndSelection.limitations: Representative static samples were inspected, not every interpolation frame or continuously watched animation. Audio playback and audiovisual synchronization were not evaluated.

recommendation: Retain current Sarcos runtime behavior and appearance. No reproducible Sarcos-specific defect from this focused audit requires a runtime change.

checksActuallyRun: Eight production sprites in both facings
Movement, facing, double jump and landing on both sides

Two bounces and terminal explosion on both sides
Blast idle/front/rear guards and no duplicate damage on both sides
Special energy, combo win gates, connected chase-input combos and super gates on both sides
Intro action gate and production intro/selection/cinematic samples in both facings
